sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored: A New Local AI Weapon for Cybersecurity
sources.snippet: What happens when you take a powerful coding model, run it locally, and reduce the restrictions that can get in the way of legitimate security research? Qwen3.8-27B community builds are attracting attention for code review, vulnerability analysis, malware research, and agentic DFIR workflows.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Benchmarks: Official and Independent Results
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at maximum reasoning effort and 61.7 on SWE-bench Pro per Qwen's own evaluation. It leads its comparison set on agentic coding and computer-use benchmarks while trailing frontier models on Humanity's Last Exam and GPQA Diamond.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: The official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint serves directly on a 950PR — no offline re-quantization and no --quantization ascend. vLLM Ascend reads quant_method: fp8 and weight_block_size straight from the checkpoint, expands the weight_scale_inv tiles at load time and re-quantizes to MXFP8 on 950.
